## Add me to the network

| field | value |
|-------|-------|
| **name** | <!-- your display name --> |
| **id (suggested)** | <!-- lowercase-slug, e.g. jane-smith --> |
| **url** | <!-- your website URL --> |
| **bio** | <!-- optional, 1 sentence --> |
| **avatar** | <!-- optional, direct image URL --> |
| **knows** | <!-- id of someone already in the graph that you know --> |

_Once reviewed, I'll add the JSON entry to `assets/data/social_graph.json`._
